name: Cancer Staging Overview
description: Cancer staging describes the anatomical extent of disease using clinical and pathological information

name: Clinical TNM cTNM
description: Clinical stage established before definitive treatment using clinical examination and diagnostic investigations

name: Pathological TNM pTNM
description: Pathological stage established using preoperative evidence plus surgical and histopathological findings

name: Physical Examination
description: Physical examination findings used as clinical staging evidence

name: Diagnostic Imaging
description: Imaging findings used to assess primary tumour regional nodes and distant disease

name: Endoscopy
description: Endoscopic findings where applicable to the cancer type

name: Biopsy Evidence
description: Biopsy and cytology findings used in diagnosis and clinical staging

name: Laboratory Evidence
description: Relevant laboratory and biomarker findings used with other staging evidence

name: T Primary Tumour
description: T describes the size or direct extent of the primary tumour

name: TX
description: Primary tumour cannot be assessed

name: T0
description: No evidence of primary tumour

name: Tis Carcinoma In Situ
description: Carcinoma in situ without invasion of surrounding tissues

name: T1 through T4
description: Increasing tumour size or increasing local extent; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: N Regional Lymph Nodes
description: N describes involvement of regional lymph nodes

name: NX
description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed

name: N0
description: No regional lymph-node metastasis

name: N1 through N3
description: Increasing regional lymph-node involvement; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: M Distant Metastasis
description: M describes the presence or absence of distant metastasis

name: M0
description: No distant metastasis identified

name: M1
description: Distant metastasis is present

name: Stage 0 Description
description: In situ disease; applicable only to cancer types that define a Stage 0 group

name: Stage I Description
description: Usually localized early-stage invasive cancer; exact grouping is cancer-specific

name: Stage II Description
description: Greater local extent or limited regional involvement according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Stage III Description
description: Locally advanced or more extensive regional disease according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Stage IV Description
description: Cancer with distant metastatic disease according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Staging Interpretation Caution
description: TNM definitions and stage-group combinations vary by cancer type; not every cancer has Stage 0; stage is not the only determinant of prognosis or treatment

name: Staging Metadata
description: Patient; cancer type; assessment date; clinical or pathological prefix; evidence source; T category; N category; M category and final stage group
